answer: Proof of Stake serves as a primary Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to bond collateral to gain network influence. Like strata within a shale formation, capital deposits define the hierarchy. This economic terrace ensures that creating a haven for malicious actors is prohibitively expensive, as an attacker must acquire a majority stake to manipulate consensus, effectively tethering the cost of identity fabrication to the real-world value of the underlying network assets.
